notes: Rates, standard deduction and $110 personal credits are from the Division of Revenue's 2026 PIT-EST instructions (revised 11/10/25); Delaware amounts are statutory, not indexed.
Proposals to add higher brackets above $125,000-$150,000 (HB 13 and its substitutes) were not enacted for 2026 as of verification.

The same rate table applies to every filing status. Married couples may file 'combined separate' (status 4), applying the table to each spouse's income separately, which often lowers tax; the calculator applies the table to joint income.
Additional $2,500 standard deduction for age 65+/blind, $110 credits for dependents and age 60+, pension exclusions, itemized deductions and other credits are not modeled.

seDeduction.note: Delaware starts from federal AGI, which already reflects the deductible half of SE tax.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions deducted in federal AGI carry through.

qbi.note: The QBI deduction is taken after federal AGI; Delaware has no equivalent.

localIncomeTax.note: The City of Wilmington levies an earned income (wage and net profits) tax on residents and on nonresidents working in the city. No other Delaware locality taxes income. Not modeled.

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if Delaware tax due in excess of withholding can reasonably be expected to exceed $800.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No penalty if each installment is paid on time and totals at least 90% of 2026 tax or 100% of 2025 tax (110% if 2025 federal AGI exceeded $150,000, or $75,000 MFS). Not required if there was no 2025 liability for a full 12-month year.
estimatedTax.form: Form PIT-EST (Declaration of Estimated Income Tax for Individuals) or tax.delaware.gov

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $110 Certificate of Formation for a domestic LLC (Delaware Division of Corporations; optional certified copy $50).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: None: Delaware LLCs do not file an annual report.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: $400 annual LLC tax, due on or before June 1 each year (no proration; $200 penalty plus 1.5% monthly interest if late).
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: Delaware gross receipts tax applies to sole proprietors and LLCs: 0.3983% for professional/occupational services, with an exclusion of the first $100,000 of gross receipts per month (monthly filing). Plus a $75 annual business license ($25 per additional location).
